title: Operations agents
claim: Agents that handle the busywork around your team — with a human on the risky steps.

page.tagline: Bring your tools in over MCP, gate risky actions on approval, wake the agent on a schedule.

scenarios.name: Bring your tools in, unchanged
scenarios.text: MCP servers you already run stay where they are; their tools arrive as ordinary Oribos tools — plain objects, no registry.

scenarios.name: A human on the risky step
scenarios.text: Approval-listed calls suspend instead of executing — approve to continue, reject and the model replans; the snapshot is JSON and survives the process.

scenarios.name: Wake it on a schedule, not a worker
scenarios.text: tick() fired by a platform cron is the first-class shape; @oribos/croner supplies the cron expressions, signals wake or inject into a thread.
